Hi Samantha — great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kickoff.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood inference integration for Acme's customer support summarization workflow; target 30% reduction in average handle time and maintain >=95% fidelity on labeled prompt tests.

Suggested success criteria (we discussed this on the call):
- Latency: 99th percentile token latency < 150ms under expected load (sample test with 100 concurrent sessions)
- Quality: Top-line accuracy on Acme evaluation set >= 95% vs. labeled outputs (we'll use the test prompt set you shared)
- Cost baseline: Estimated per-1000-token unit cost target for comparison (we'll provide quantized and non-quantized profiles)

POC evaluation plan and ownership:
- Acme: Samantha (PM) — provide sample data, evaluation criteria, and decision-makers for final readout
- Redwood: Marissa (AE) — overall POC coordination and cadence; Michael (Solutions Eng) — infra & performance validation; Dev (SRE) — sandbox access and onboarding

Proposed timeline / milestones:
- Kickoff (technical & ops alignment): May 11, 2027 — 60min (introductions, access, data ingestion plan)
- Week 1 deliverable: sandbox env + baseline inference demo (Redwood) — May 18
- Weekly check-ins: every Wed 30min starting May 18 through final readout
- Final readout & decision: June 8, 2027 — 45min (performance, cost, recommendation)

Attachments I'm sending: Acme_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (outline + ownership) and a POC checklist template. Please review and flag any changes.

Immediate next steps (can we confirm these by end of week?):
1) Samantha to confirm kickoff date/time for May 11 or propose alternatives.
2) Acme to share a redacted sample dataset and any IP/SSO requirements for sandbox access.
3) Redwood to provision a sandbox and share invite + runbook.

Thanks — I'll draft a calendar invite once we confirm kickoff.

Best,
